content.text: For digital creators in Zimbabwe, like many others in countries restricted by Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy, setting up a digital commerce infrastructure that integrates with cryptocurrency payments can be a daunting task. This post breaks down Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation, exploring its capabilities, architecture, and practical applications, especially in the context of countries with strict payment processing regulations.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based scripting platform that enables automation and integration with third-party services, making it an ideal solution for digital commerce infrastructure. It allows creators to automate tasks, such as storing orders, generating download links, and sending email notifications, all within their Google Drive account. This scripting platform is particularly useful for creators in countries where traditional payment processors are blocked or restricted.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of Google Apps Script for digital commerce automation involves several key components: Google Apps Script as the scripting engine, Google Drive for data storage, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. When a payment is received, the Google Apps Script triggers a webhook, which then sends a notification to the NOWPayments API to verify the payment. Once verified, the script retrieves the order details and generates a download link, which is then sent to the customer via email.

How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital delivery works through a specific technical sequence that eliminates every manual step. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain for incoming transactions to your configured wallet address. When a transaction receives the configured number of on-chain confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App receives this request, validates the webhook signature against the secret key you configured, reads the payment amount and transaction hash from the payload, confirms the transaction independently on the blockchain, logs the order to your database, generates a receipt, creates a time-limited download link for the product file, and sends the delivery email. The entire sequence completes in under 30 seconds from payment confirmation in almost all cases. Nothing in this sequence requires your presence, your attention, or any manual action.
